question: Does the default (A19 profile v18) score higher when it also rushes an army with exactly four strikers and exactly one shooter, without losing against itself?

candidate.setupRule: Striker rush when the seat has at least four strikers and the enemy has at most three strikers, or exactly four strikers and at least ONE creature with a ranged attack (profile v18: at least two). Casters without a ranged attack do not count. Plan, formation and draft are unchanged.

control: Profile v18: rush at most three enemy strikers, or exactly four with at least two shooters; shooterless Movement; matchup draft.
why: On development tasks, against an army with exactly four strikers: no shooter -12.8 for rushing (n 98), one shooter +16.4 (n 61: +23.1 against owner-shaped armies n 26, +30.8 and 0.0 against the two mixed populations), two shooters +18.4 (n 223). On the bank of confirmation C (consumed) the one-shooter tasks measured +3.7 (n 108). Post hoc on both, hence this bank.

populations.owner: Opponent drafts strikers from the bundle and at levels 2-3 (fast first) and casters at levels 1 and 4, stock setup: the shape of the owner's recorded armies.
populations.mixB12: Opponent drafts strikers from the bundle and levels 1-2 and the shipped native pick at levels 3-4, stock setup.
populations.mixB34: Opponent drafts strikers from the bundle and levels 3-4 and the shipped native pick at levels 1-2, stock setup.

bank.families: all 299 families; allocated for this study, no development use; audited against 446 ledgers and both earlier pools
bank.playedTasks: Only tasks where the rule changes the setup: 453 (owner), 199 (mixB12), 275 (mixB34), 21 (mirror). On every other task the two arms are the same game.
bank.unit: one task = one draft seed, doctrine pair, map and pick order; one game per arm from the candidate seat; both arms play identical drafted armies

primaryEndpoint: Mean over all changed tasks of owner, mixB12 and mixB34 of candidate-arm score minus control-arm score for the candidate seat. 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples over draft tasks (all changed rows of one task move together), seed 20261124.

gates.G1: Lower bound of the primary interval above zero.
gates.G2: No map with a negative point estimate of the primary endpoint, and no opponent population (owner, mixB12, mixB34) with a changed-task estimate below -5 points.
gates.G3: Mirror guard: the difference over all 2,691 mirror tasks is at least -1 point.
gates.G4: Candidate-arm games with a quality error not more than control-arm games with one (all populations).
gates.G5: A rerun of 30 changed owner tasks on a second host reproduces the candidate digests.
gates.G6: Mean CPU per changed game of the candidate arm at most 1.25 times the control arm (owner, mixB12, mixB34), same host and tree.

notClaimed: Strength against people; any effect on armies with a different shape; an effect over all games (the rule changes 10-17% of the games against these opponents and about 1% of mirrors).

execution.runner: life-run5.ts; control spec v18.json (owner, mixB12, mixB34) and v18-both.json (mirror); candidate spec v19.json and v19-vs-v18.json
execution.draftGenerator: league-drafts2.ts (reproduces the registered league-drafts.ts 198/198 on the mirror and both mixed opponents); candidate seat S:B1234:val with explore/table-a.json (RUSH_PRIOR=0.5); opponents S:B23:fast:K14, S:B12:fast, S:B34:fast, S:B1234:val
execution.analysis: confirm_e_analyze.py (dry-run on development rows before registration)
